ari: FYI -- postmortem action items for INC-901. We need to reassign a couple of owners and confirm due dates before EOD tomorrow.

zara: I can take the DB migration verification (item 3). ETA Wed 9am PT? :+1:

mike: I had item 2 (canary rollback checklist) originally, but I can swap to the telemetry dashboards if someone else wants 2.

jules: I'll take the canary rollback checklist. Can we move its due date to Thu COB? still blocked on infra slot.

ari: jules, noted. jules please add the exact infra slot you need. mike, thanks — which dashboards exactly? list names.

mike: Planning to cover: gen-inference-latency, kv-cache-hits, tail-latency-p99. I'll add the dashboard links in the doc.

oliver-pm: Heads-up: customer support needs sign-off on item 5 (user data export notice) by Fri EOD. Who's the owner?

ari: No owner currently. oli, can you take 5 or should we assign to security?

oliver-pm: I can shepherd it but prefer eng-security to own final sign-off.

zara: tagging @eng-security (security channel) — can someone confirm availability? :wave:

deploy-bot: canary-deploy started for r-inference v2.7 at 2024-04-03T16:12:03Z

jules: infra slot request: need 2h window Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC for canary failover test.

ari: noted. eng-infra, pls confirm. @mike I'll need the dashboard queries by EOD today so I can add to eval playbook.

mike: will post queries here in a sec:

```sql
-- tail p99 query
SELECT percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) FROM request_logs WHERE model='r-inference' AND timeframe='last_1h';
```

mike: posting links: https://dashboards.company.com/d/gen-inference-latency

jules: FYI I've updated the action tracker: https://rwd.in/rca/inc901/actions

ari: owners recap:
- item1: ari (runbook edits) due 1719960000 (Thu 18:00 UTC)
- item2: jules (canary rollback) due 1719990000 (Fri 05:00 UTC)
- item3: zara (DB migration verify) due 1719950000 (Wed 09:00 UTC)
- item4: mike (dashboards + alerts) due 1719943200 (Tue 23:00 UTC)
- item5: eng-security / oliver-pm (notice) due 1720053600 (next Fri 23:59 UTC)

zara: small note: item3 depends on infra change INC-901-MIGRATE-2. Need eng-infra to confirm change window.

mike: re: alerts -- suggest adding early-warning rule for kv-cache hitrate < 70%.

jules: added that suggestion to the tracker.

ari: can everyone ack their due date? reply with "ack" and any blockers.

zara: ack

jules: ack — blocker: infra slot confirmation

mike: ack — will post queries by 21:00 UTC

oliver-pm: ack — I'll loop in security on ownership and escalate if needed

eng-infra: infra: we can confirm Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC slot, but need runbook steps from jules by EOD Mon.

jules: will draft runbook steps tonight and ping here when done.

ari: perfect — I'll close the loop once runbook is in. Thanks all :pray:

mike: small follow-up: who will own the postmortem writeup? I can draft initial section on telemetry if nobody else.

ari: mike, please draft telemetry + timeline. oliver-pm, please own customer impact section.

oliver-pm: will do. sending a short template to the tracker.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy completed (10% traffic). No errors observed.

ari: last note — if anyone needs to swap tasks, ping here before EOD so I can update the tracker.

jules: update posted: runbook draft https://rwd.in/rca/inc901/runbook-draft

ari: thanks, closing loop for now. we'll reconvene in async thread tomorrow 09:00 UTC if anything changes.
